description: Find 10 hotels or apartments in any city with price for your dates, rating, review count, stars, address and link. Prices show when you send travel dates. Use it when: A travel task needs real places to stay in a city, with prices and ratings. Not for: Booking a room; it returns links, it does not reserve. Returns: 10 properties: name, type, price for your dates (when sent), rating, review count, stars, address, coordinates, facilities and link. Typical time: about 41 s. Price: $0.054 per search (up to 10 hotels), charged only on success. One call = up to 10 hotels.
name: hotel-search
title: Hotel search by city
